title: Corner C3 - Mode Switcher Design Spec
summary: Visual spec for the three-mode switcher: Game, Checklist, Megaboard. Nav bar design, active states, keyboard shortcuts, mobile adaptation.
content:
Corner C3: Mode Switcher Design Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. The control that lets users flip between three worlds. Must feel instant.

The Concept

Three modes. One seamless container. The mode switcher is the remote control for Corner. It should feel like switching tabs in a browser: fast, obvious, no cognitive load. The user never feels lost about which mode they're in.

The switcher lives in the HUD bar (top, 48px). It replaces the current center tab area (Last Session / By Project / Upcoming / Add New). Those tabs move INSIDE the expanded drawer. The mode switcher is always visible.

Desktop Layout (>= 1024px)

Position

  • Inside the top HUD bar, centered horizontally.
  • Left of the mode switcher: CORNER. logo + LOCAL badge
  • Right of the mode switcher: HUD expand chevron
  • The mode switcher IS the center element of the bar.

Component Structure

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [CORNER.]   [Game]  [Checklist]  [Megaboard]                       [v]  |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Tab Design

Three tabs, horizontal row, centered in the bar.

Inactive Tab:

  • Font: Space Grotesk 500, 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.08em
  • Color: #6B7280
  • Icon: 16px Lucide icon, same color, to the LEFT of the label
  • Gap between icon and label: 6px
  • Padding: 0 14px (horizontal), full bar height (48px, vertically centered)
  • Border-bottom: 2px solid transparent
  • Hover: color transitions to #A0A0A0, 150ms ease
  • Cursor: pointer

Active Tab:

  • Color: #FDF6EC
  • Icon color: #E85D26 (orange, always the accent for the active mode)
  • Border-bottom: 2px solid #E85D26
  • Font-weight: 600 (slightly bolder than inactive)
  • No background change. The underline is the only active indicator.

Tab Icons (Lucide):

Mode Icon Label Keyboard
Game Gamepad2 or Map GAME 1
Checklist ListTodo CHECKLIST 2
Megaboard LayoutDashboard MEGABOARD 3

Bobby already has ListTodo imported. Use Map for Game (it represents the isometric world). Use LayoutDashboard for Megaboard (grid/dashboard feel).

Transition Between Modes

When the user clicks a different tab:

  1. Active underline slides from current tab to new tab (150ms ease-out). Use a motion div that translates horizontally.
  2. The mode content area crossfades: current mode opacity 1->0 (100ms), new mode opacity 0->1 (150ms, 50ms delay after old finishes).
  3. Total perceived transition: ~200ms. Fast enough to feel instant, slow enough to not be jarring.

Keyboard Shortcut Hints

On hover over each tab, show the keyboard shortcut as a tiny badge:

  • Position: top-right corner of the tab, offset (-2px, -2px) from the text
  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)
  • Border-radius: 3px
  • Padding: 1px 4px
  • Font: JetBrains Mono 500, 8px, #6B7280
  • Content: "1", "2", or "3"
  • Fade in on hover (100ms), fade out on mouse leave (100ms)
  • Never shown on mobile (no keyboard)

HUD Drawer Tab Relocation

The current 4 tabs (Last Session, By Project, Upcoming, Add New) move from the collapsed bar into the expanded drawer as sub-tabs:

When the HUD drawer is EXPANDED:

  • A horizontal tab bar appears at the top of the drawer content area (below the collapsed bar)
  • Same styling as before: Space Grotesk 500, 12px, uppercase
  • These tabs only affect the drawer content. They do NOT switch modes.

When the HUD drawer is COLLAPSED:

  • The mode switcher is the only interactive element in the center

This separation is clean: mode switcher = global navigation (always visible). HUD tabs = content filter (visible when drawer is open).

Mobile Layout (< 768px)

On mobile, the mode switcher moves to a bottom tab bar (separate from the chat bar).

Position

  • Fixed bottom, ABOVE the chat bar
  • Chat bar: fixed bottom, 56px height
  • Mode tab bar: fixed bottom at 56px offset, 44px height
  • Total bottom area: 100px (tab bar + chat bar)

Layout

+------------------------------------------+
|                                          |
|           M O D E   C O N T E N T       |
|                                          |
+------------------------------------------+
| [Game icon]  [Checklist icon]  [Megaboard icon] |  <- 44px tab bar
+------------------------------------------+
| [Agent] [text input...........] [Send]    |  <- 56px chat bar
+------------------------------------------+

Mobile Tab Design

Inactive Tab:

  • Icon only (no label on mobile). 20px Lucide icon.
  • Color: #6B7280
  • Flex: 1 (equal width thirds)
  • Height: 44px, centered vertically
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.95)
  • Haptic feedback on tap (if available via Vibration API)

Active Tab:

  • Icon color: #E85D26
  • Small dot indicator below icon: 4px circle, #E85D26
  • No underline (different indicator from desktop for thumb-friendly clarity)

Tab Bar:

  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.95)
  • Border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Backdrop-filter: blur(16px)
  • Safe area inset: respect env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for iPhone notch/home bar

Mobile Top HUD Simplification

On mobile, the top HUD bar (48px) REMOVES the mode switcher (it's at the bottom now). The top bar becomes:

  • Left: CORNER. logo
  • Right: HUD expand chevron

The center is empty or can show the current mode name as a label (optional, low priority).

Tablet Layout (768-1023px)

Same as desktop. The mode switcher stays in the top bar. No bottom tab bar. The 48px top bar is large enough for the three tabs at tablet width.

State Persistence

  • Last-used mode saved to localStorage key: corner-mode
  • On load: read localStorage, default to 'game' if not set
  • URL routing (per Steve's C3 spec):
    • /app or /app/game = Game mode
    • /app/checklist = Checklist mode
    • /app/megaboard = Megaboard mode
  • If URL specifies a mode, use that (override localStorage). Then save to localStorage.
  • Deep links: /app/checklist/bobby loads Checklist mode with Bobby selected.

Shared Layers Across Modes

These elements persist and DON'T change when switching modes:

Element Game Checklist Megaboard
Mode switcher (top/bottom bar) Visible Visible Visible
Chat bar (bottom) Visible Visible Visible
Task HUD drawer (top) Available HIDDEN (Checklist IS the task view) Available
Mini-map Visible (when zoomed) Hidden Hidden
Notification toasts Visible Visible Visible

The chat bar stays at the bottom in ALL modes. When typing to an agent in Checklist mode, the response streams the same way. The chat bar is a global layer.

Color Treatment

The mode switcher uses a single accent color (#E85D26, AOM orange) for the active state. It does NOT change color based on which mode is active. This keeps the switcher feeling neutral and navigation-like, not "themed" to each mode.

Exception: In Megaboard mode, if Bobby wants to tint the entire chrome with a subtle dark-mode RPG feel, the mode switcher can adapt its background to match (from rgba(10,15,30,0.85) to rgba(5,8,15,0.95)). The tabs themselves keep the same colors.

Animation Spec (CSS)

/* Sliding underline indicator */
.mode-indicator {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: #E85D26;
  transition: left 150ms ease-out, width 150ms ease-out;
}

/* Tab text color transition */
.mode-tab {
  transition: color 150ms ease;
}

/* Mode content crossfade */
.mode-content-enter {
  opacity: 0;
}
.mode-content-enter-active {
  opacity: 1;
  transition: opacity 150ms ease 50ms;
}
.mode-content-exit {
  opacity: 1;
}
.mode-content-exit-active {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 100ms ease;
}

Bobby should use Framer Motion AnimatePresence for the content crossfade. The underline can be a motion.div with layoutId for smooth translation.

Three modes. One switcher. Instant transitions. The user is never lost. Bobby builds it in Step 3 of the C3 build order.
